name: postman-custedu
description: Manage Vandelay Industries customer profiles, contact details, vehicles, and communication preferences.  This API returns **PII** (names, phone numbers, addresses, dates of birth). When called by an agent, traffic should flow through the Fabric Gateway so PII-redaction plugins can protect downstream LLMs. Sensitive fields are returned masked unless the caller holds the `customers:pii:read` scope. ### Authentication and rate limits - Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; see `bearerAuth` for the token format and personas. - Each token is limited to 600 requests per minute. Responses include `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`;   over the limit you receive `429` with `Retry-After`. - A `POST` retried with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body replays the original response and adds `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. - `customers:pii:read` unmasks `dateOfBirth`. `customers:delete` is required to deactivate a customer (`DELETE /customers/v1/customers/{customerId}`, otherwise `403`).
